Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.server

Interface EditAuthority

public interface EditAuthority
The loader-specific half of stack world edits: who performs automation, and whether a claim or logging mod vetoes an edit. WorldEdits owns the vanilla mechanics and actor propagation.

The loader's entry point installs an implementation via WorldEdits.setAuthority(com.github.crittscott.somestacks.server.EditAuthority) before any world logic can run.
